title: router-contextd live.json
description: One self-contained generation of the records router-contextd derives from router_snapshot.yaml (D01-D04) plus its own findings and package record (D04, D19), written with temp file + rename. A read-only derivative: router_snapshot.yaml stays the source of truth for the planner/grounding/executor. Readable by trusted services only; LLM context goes through the scoped reader. When the source is lost the last good records stay with their real capture time (source.status and source.age_s say so).

stream.description: changes after every collector start; generations of different streams are not comparable

truncated_kinds.description: kinds cut to keep the file under storage_budget.live_file_bytes
